text: Setting clear goals is essential for any project's success. One popular method is using SMART goals, which means making goals specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Instead of saying "improve the website," a SMART goal would be "increase website traffic by 20% within three months." It is also helpful to define milestones, which are important checkpoints along the way, and deliverables, the final products or results you must complete. Finally, make sure all stakeholders agree on these goals from the beginning. When everyone shares the same clear objectives, the project is much more likely to succeed.
